targets.title: “Not for all the tea in China!” Political ideology and the avoidance of dissonance-arousing situations
targets.evidence_quote: Study 1 was a close replication of Nam et al. (2013) with a few modifications.
targets.outcome_quote: In two studies and a meta-analysis of five studies, we found no support for ideological asymmetry in dissonance avoidance using the standard induced compliance procedure.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Both close and conceptual attempts fail to find ideological asymmetry, and the general discussion states an overall null-support verdict. Ancillary personality and manipulation checks are not additional original-paper targets.
